QuestInfo.name: Bad for Business
QuestInfo.0: A note on the #b#p617##k in #m10005070# asks for help.
QuestInfo.1: A note from the #b#p614##k on the #b#p617##k in #m10005070# says #r#o23#s#k keep scaring away customers with their stares. I need to defeat #r30 #o23#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #o23#s and took the pay pinned to the #b#p617##k. Now customers can shop in #m10005070# in peace... at least for a while.

0.0: (A bright new note is pinned over the old ones: "HELP WANTED! We have everything! Except... customers. Signed, the #b#p614##k.")
0.1: ("It's those #r#o23#s#k! They come out of the caves and just stare. Stare, stare, stare. Nobody can shop when a giant eye is watching them!")
0.2: ("Please defeat #r30 #o23#s#k. A merchant can't fight, but a merchant can pay! Come back to this board when it's done.")

yes.0: (You tear a slip off the note. It says the #o23#s live in #m10005071# and the caves past it.)

no.0: (You leave the note on the board.)

1.0: (A pouch is now pinned under the note, with a tag: "For whoever beat the #o23#s. I haven't felt this un-stared-at in weeks!")
1.1: ("Here's your pay, as promised. Come by the store any time. We have everything!")

mob.0: (The note still asks for #r30 #o23#s#k to be defeated. There are still too many out there.)
